broker_receipt: Original request/parsed-response receive times, HTTP status, receipt ID, body byte count; no external bytes estimate promoted to actual wire bytes.
Original private response SHA256/length and sanitized shape summary; no raw account or position IDs in Git/chat.

already_documented_fields_to_observe.ts: Presence/type/native milliseconds and response-time semantics only; never generation alias
already_documented_fields_to_observe.data.rows: Array, length<=500, full key/type/nullability census for this bounded page
already_documented_fields_to_observe.data.total_positions: Presence/type and consistency only; absent remains unknown
already_documented_fields_to_observe.data.next_cursor: Presence/type/has-next flag; no automatic next page
already_documented_fields_to_observe.rows.symbol: Exact native source symbol; no reconstructed identity
already_documented_fields_to_observe.rows.est_liq_price: Nullable actual positive estimate; null/zero do not produce zones
already_documented_fields_to_observe.rows.mark_price: Actual numeric scalar/type, native currency requires independent proof
already_documented_fields_to_observe.rows.notional: Actual numeric scalar/type/nullability and explicit unit/basis proof; not price*qty-derived
already_documented_fields_to_observe.rows.opened_at: If present, opening-date semantics only, never snapshot freshness

stable_position_identifier.check: Observe actual complete keys. Only configure a returned identifier after primary stability/uniqueness scope proof; one response cannot establish temporal stability.
stable_position_identifier.sanitized_output: Presence/type/nonempty/duplicate counts; opaque digest only if admitted, not raw values.

snapshot_generation_time.check: Record a generation field only if actually returned and independently documented. Otherwise leave null and use only the separately reviewed bound contract.

raw_currency_or_instrument_reference.check: Record only identifiers/currency fields that really exist. No invented oracle ID, address, base token or automatic mapping from symbol.

not_solved_by_one_response: Exact raw money-unit semantics when not explicitly documented
USDC/USDT conversion and independent venue-price basis
